scope: Opted-in Baltic mode/reload cancellation; missing-file, absent-ID and insufficient-resident-capacity rejection preserves old layout and pending composition; unopted German self-reload preserves composition. HIGH/LOW BIOS/DOS matrices plus current-binary Baltic input/selection/corruption and Russian regressions.
ru_country_scope: Russian regressions use the base image COUNTRY.SYS containing the unchanged Russian records; its actual hash is captured per case. All positive cases require the current KEYB and KEYBRD2 binaries, and Baltic cases additionally require current COUNTRY.SYS.
guest_protocol: GROUPED_INPUT accepts complete multi-word results. Zero-word arm steps physically set Caps, wait for the guest RU_KEY_ARMED acknowledgement, then release Caps (using Shift for German typewriter Caps). The guest requires no queued character and released modifiers. CAPACITY_PROOF queries KEYB, rejects FFFF or an end beyond the resident MCB, and host checks constant limits across phases.
startup_scope: Reload matrices initially allocate from ET/KEYBRD2.SYS so all supported target tables fit. Dedicated small-allocation runs initially load GR/KEYBOARD.SYS and require rejection of the larger Baltic library without losing German pending composition. They do not claim that an existing smaller resident allocation can grow.
retention: Ordered input oracles and phase plans are deduplicated by content hash. Every case retains serial output and startup configuration. The final expected include belongs to the last compiled phase in multi-program runs; the phase plan maps all commands to ranges in the full input oracle.
remaining: Pending state on additional malformed-resource and page-transition failures; additional modifier/fallback/hardware-specific edges.
